recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck pulling into a quiet {street} at dusk, a porch light on, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering
recipe.motion_template: The truck rolls to a stop as the porch light comes on

en.primary_text: Class A team drivers earn $2,500 per week with weekly pay — no waiting on your money. If you have a co-driver or are ready to find one, this run keeps you moving and pays you every week. Join our team.
en.headline: Team up. Get paid weekly.

es.primary_text: Conductores Clase A en equipo ganan $2,500 por semana con pago semanal — sin esperar tu dinero. Si tienes copiloto o estás listo para encontrar uno, esta ruta te mantiene rodando y te paga cada semana. Únete al equipo.
es.headline: En equipo. Pago semanal.

en.primary_text: Class A team driving at $2,500 per week, paid weekly. No net-15, no delays — your money is in your account every week. Bring a partner or run with one of ours. Apply now and get rolling.
en.headline: $2,500/week, team seats

es.primary_text: Conducción en equipo Clase A con $2,500 por semana, pago semanal. Sin retrasos — tu dinero llega cada semana. Trae tu copiloto o corre con uno de los nuestros. Aplica ya y empieza a rodar.
es.headline: $2,500/semana, en equipo

en.primary_text: If you are a Class A driver ready to team up, the pay is $2,500 per week and it lands in your account every week. Two drivers, one truck, steady money. Find out if this seat fits you.
en.headline: Weekly pay, team driving

es.primary_text: Si eres conductor Clase A listo para manejar en equipo, el pago es $2,500 por semana directo a tu cuenta cada semana. Dos conductores, un tráiler, ingreso fijo. Averigua si este asiento es para ti.
es.headline: Pago semanal, rutas en equipo
